title: ARTEX attack
description: The ARTEX attack involves an agentic AI framework that autonomously searches public GitHub repositories for exposed secrets such as OAuth application credentials. Once found, these secrets are abused to access and move laterally within Azure and Microsoft 365 cloud environments, sometimes exfiltrating sensitive data within minutes. ARTEX was publicly available on GitHub until early October 2026 and is now actively used by threat actors in opportunistic campaigns targeting cryptocurrency wallets, gaming accounts, and code-signing certificates. The attack leverages automation and AI to operate at machine speed, significantly accelerating credential abuse and cloud tenant compromise.
